fullPassage: We think we're being logical, objective, and rational — and therefore accurate in our analysis, judgment, and decisions. So we think that if other people are logical, objective, and rational, they will agree with us and see what we see. But the opposite is the case. Every human brain is different. Everyone's life experience is different. Everyone's desires and knowledge are different. You might think you're being realistic — that is, that your ideas match reality, but that's impossible. It's only your interpretation of reality, which will always be different from someone else's. When two nations play each other in the World Cup, the fans of each country criticize the referees for missing all the infractions that the other team commits. Without fail, each fan base believes that the referees are biased against their team.

Everyone's life experience is different. Everyone's desires and knowledge are different. You might think you're being realistic — that is, that your ideas match reality, but that's impossible. It's only your interpretation of reality, which will always be different from someone else's. When two nations play each other in the World Cup, the fans of each country criticize the referees for missing all the infractions that the other team commits. Without fail, each fan base believes that the referees are biased against their team.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① the opposite: 정반대 — 논리적이면 동의할 것이라 생각하지만 '정반대가 사실이다'라는 맥락에 부합 ←정답
❌ ② the standard: 기준 — 반대 상황을 설명하는 맥락에 부적합
❌ ③ the solution: 해결책 — 문제 해결이 아닌 반대 현상을 말하는 맥락
❌ ④ the evidence: 증거 — 정반대라는 역설적 상황을 나타내는 데 부적합
det.tip: the opposite is the case = 정반대가 사실이다

questions.passage: We think we're being logical, objective, and rational — and therefore accurate in our analysis, judgment, and decisions. So we think that if other people are logical, objective, and rational, they will agree with us and see what we see. But the opposite is the case. Every human brain is different. Everyone's life experience is different. Everyone's desires and knowledge are different. You might think you're being realistic — that is, that your ideas match reality, but that's impossible. It's only your interpretation of reality, which will always be different from someone else's. When two nations play each other in the World Cup, the fans of each country criticize the referees for missing all the infractions that the other team commits. __________, each fan base believes that the referees are biased against their team.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① By contrast: 이와 대조적으로 — 앞 문장과 대조가 아닌 확인/강조의 맥락
✅ ② Without fail: 틀림없이 — 각 팬 집단이 '틀림없이' 심판이 편향되어 있다고 믿는다는 확실성의 맥락에 부합 ←정답
❌ ③ In addition: 게다가 — 추가 정보가 아닌 확실성을 강조하는 맥락
❌ ④ On the whole: 전반적으로 — 개별 팬 집단 각각이 확실히 믿는다는 맥락에 부적합
